findings.statement: The live MultiproofConeRef.Funs was extracted from reference.rs sha256 32548b0d (tree d28944b2a05); every exit-0 Kani receipt names the later reference.rs e812aae3 (tree 7bb8b8b2f83 and after). The two files differ in exactly two lines, both #[cfg_attr(kani, kani::requires/ensures)] on read32. PCWB_E007 (e812aae3 tree 8c029994865) re-extracts MultiproofConeRef.Funs identical to the live module except one Source line-number comment (read32 at 111 not 113) and Types identical modulo the same post-processing as E004. The Kani contract therefore names a different hash from the one that produced the live module; the difference does not reach the non-Kani MIR, but this job did not rerun Kani and does not transfer the contract by itself. Lead decision whether the cfg(kani)-only difference is accepted as the identical function.
